profile.name: 真实USB设备通信组件
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件组件，用于在实验系统中直接访问通用USB设备。它提供设备查找、USB配置设置、设备复位、接口占用与释放、控制传输、原始数据读取等功能，适合与未专门建模的USB实验设备或自定义硬件进行底层通信。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for direct access to generic USB devices in laboratory systems. It provides device discovery, USB configuration, device reset, interface claim/release, control transfers, and raw data reads, making it suitable for low-level communication with custom hardware or USB-based lab equipment that is not otherwise specifically modeled.
